audit_independence: C source authors differ from the timestamp model author. The archive auditor authored that model and the inline runner; archived recomputation is not a second independent semantic model or an independent review of that runner design.

observability: Eight descriptors per source were redirected and unobserved. Both-unwritable exit 6 does not prove both failures were observed. Missing cleanup output cannot prove cleanup after a trace failure.

managed_prototypes.boundary: Abstract source-state checks do not prove native ABI or reclamation. Silent trace-failure cleanup needs a separate allocator observer. No production memory mechanism is selected.
